# FDG4036

> DO NOT use an enum for open sets (such as the operating system version, names of your friends, etc.).

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.8 Enum Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Whether a set is open is a design judgment; not machine-checkable.
